what: A smoke-like noise edge (7-layer fbm warped twice as a domain warp) rises from the bottom of the panel and covers one solid-color section with another. When tied to scroll, progress runs 0→1 while passing the panel (1 to 2 uncovers again from the bottom), opacity also bleeds in through the same noise, and past 1 the light overflows and fades out. The path the mouse has crossed pushes the smoke by ×.05 through a flow map (OGL Flowmap, dissipation .99, radius .3). On the interaction panel, hovering fills progress up to .9 in 1.6s power2.out, and releasing drains it in 1.6s power1.out (WebGL)
ease: Scroll is none (progress as is) · hand enters power2.out · exits power1.out

options.from: Color before covering — Skin variable name (--kf-bg) or transparent (panel shows through), default --kf-bg · Interaction panel default transparent
options.to: Cover smoke color — skin variable name, default --kf-ink
options.start: Scroll progress start (ScrollTrigger start), default top top
options.end: Scroll progress end, default bottom bottom
options.max: Progress at scroll end, default 1 — at 2 it is covered then uncovered again from the bottom, at .4 only the bottom is slightly covered
options.alpha: Opacity (0~3), default 1 — at 0 it starts empty and spreads out during the fade range, above 1 the light overflows
options.fade: when on, opacity goes 0→alpha while the panel’s top edge travels from the bottom of the screen upward
options.fill: End progress of the fill on the hover panel, default .9
options.dur: Hand panel enter and exit duration (s), default 1.6
options.speed: Noise flow speed (per second), default scroll .01 · Interaction .05
options.velocity: on makes the noise amplitude grow with scroll speed (max 1.5)
options.[data-fx-part=start-image]·[data-fx-part: (if present) photo (img) shown before covering and after covered — changes with the smoke edge and ripples along with the flow map
